reshoot.title: Re-shoot a video

step1.label: Prepare the clip
step1.hint: Choose the clip, its framing and what the new view should reveal. Depth is analyzed once; then you aim freely.

step2.label: Aim and generate
step2.hint: Drag the preview or use the controls, key a move if you want one, then generate.

reshoot.credit: Built on Cseti's CrossView-Warp LoRA and node

pick.lead: Re-shoot any video from any angle. Move the camera anywhere, no reshoot day needed.

aim.globe: Drag the camera around your clip · scroll to move closer

reshoot.warpNote: The warp guide of a real run shows here: the clip pushed to the new camera, magenta where it has to be invented.

seed.label: Seed
seed.help: Leave empty for a new seed every take; enter a number to fix it.

prompt.dialogue: The model also generates new audio: if your video has dialogue, prompt the lines here so the new generation retains it better.
prompt.placeholder: e.g. a stone wall behind her, more wheat to the left

clip.length: This clip is {seconds} s long. Use one between 5 and 15 seconds.
clip.help: 5–15 seconds, clear subject, no black bars
clip.rejected: {name} is {seconds} s, so the current clip stays. Pick one between 5 and 15 seconds.

reshoot.distanceHelp: Distance is approximate; angles give the most control.
reshoot.keepAimHelp: Orbit the subject but keep looking where the original looked, as the training data does.
reshoot.promptHelp: Describe what should fill the areas the original camera never saw.
reshoot.generatingHelp: The first run after a quiet spell also loads the model.

take.exampleHelp: Example result: the clip re-shot from a new angle at 768p. Aim a camera of your own to try it.

empty.title: Your new angle plays here
empty.hint: Start with a 5 to 15 second clip, or pick an example.

zone.green: Inside the range the LoRA was checked on.
zone.red: Outside training. The hidden side will be invented.

dragHint.label: Drag to orbit · Scroll to move closer

reshoot.needsDepth: Analyze depth to aim a new camera.
reshoot.stale: Aspect ratio or size changed, so the depth has to be analyzed again.

move.help: Scrub the timeline under the preview, aim, press Key. Two or more keys make a move; the camera holds before the first and after the last. Aiming on a key edits it.
move.noKeys: No keys: one camera for the whole clip. Key two frames to make a move.
move.oneKey: One key holds the camera there. Key another frame to make a move.

reshoot.signIn: Sign in to read the scene.
reshoot.unavailable: Re-shoot is not available right now. Try again later.

quote.failed: Couldn’t get the price yet. Trying again…
quote.exhausted: No free runs left; next one {when}

error.busy: One take at a time: wait for this one to finish.
error.rateLimited: Too many tries for now. Try again {when}.

reshoot.demoNote: Preview: takes play the example result for now.
reshoot.clipLength: This clip is {seconds} s. Use one between 5 and 15 seconds.
reshoot.noWebgl: This preview needs WebGL2, which this browser does not offer.
